items.title: France pulls away and beats Germany 86-64.
items.author: Bryan Fonseca 🇵🇷
items.body_excerpt:
France pulls away and beats Germany 86-64.

France has one FIBA World Cup medal -- a bronze in 1953. This is already their best showing ever. 

Germany, in only their second World Cup appearance, has a chance to get their first medal. 

Spain vs. USA happens soon...
